Resolves #21671

🌿 A timeline can no longer draw its now line as dashes, nor set its header mark a pixel beside it.

The timeline cell's row separator moves inside the cell: an inset shadow replaces the grid's `border-bottom`, so each row's now line covers it and meets the next row's. The timeline header button loses its transparent left border, so its ticks, bands and now mark start where the body's track starts. A timeline that opens the locked end keeps that border, because its cells open on a 1px seam there, and its header now carries its lock region's class as a header button does. Bars now centre on the whole row, so the Gantt's dependency layer drops its `-0.5px` compensation. `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs` pins the rendered geometry in the Gantt chart and the scheduler, and in a scheduler whose timeline is locked to the end region: red on `dev`, green here.

Evidence: L3 (rendered rects measured in Chromium at 1440 × 900, both families, both neo themes, plus a locked-end arm; the new e2e spec) → L3 required (every AC is rendered geometry). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `NowLine.spec.mjs` asserts no gap between consecutive row segments (Gantt, 5 rows; scheduler, 7) in both neo themes. Outside-CI: the largest gap goes from 1 px to 0 (table below). The seam stays, as amended on #21671 |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `NowLine.spec.mjs` asserts the body line's x equals the header mark's within 0.5 px, in the center region and in a timeline locked to the end region. Outside-CI: the tables below |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `NowLine.spec.mjs` asserts a header minor tick's left edge at the body's offset, and a header non-working band over its row band (scheduler, with a non-working date set) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: where a bar crosses `now`, `NowLine.spec.mjs` lets the line take hits for one `elementFromPoint` read and checks that the bar answers. With the line raised above the bars, the same read answers the line. Z-indices unchanged: bars 1, the line 0 |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: the spec above, under `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/` |
| AC-6 | Outside-CI: the frames below |

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-1's seam clause is amended on #21671. The 2 px seam is the header button's and the grid header toolbar's bottom borders, which span every column and clip their content; the line meets them at the same x on both sides.
- `resources/css/src/gantt/Container.css`: the dependency SVG's `translateY(-.5px)` existed only for the old border (its comment read "Bars are centered inside the cell, above its 1px bottom border"), so it goes. `gantt/BasicNL.spec.mjs`'s arrow alignment passes without it.
- `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs` (from Euclid's review): its `locked_` config was reactive but set no class. It now sets `neo-locked-start` / `neo-locked-end` as `Neo.grid.header.Button#afterSetLocked` does, so `grid/header/Button.css`'s seam colour reaches a locked timeline, and `TimeAxisHeader.css` keeps the left border on `.neo-locked-end:first-child`. A unit test pins the class through end, start and unlocked.

The new arm locks the scheduler's timeline through `timelineColumn.locked = 'end'`, asserts the region class on the header and `neo-locked-end-first-column` on the cells, then the body line under the header mark within 0.5 px and the tick origin. On the two `[TOOLING_GAP]` notes:
- **The bar-over-line read** now lets the line take hits for that one `elementFromPoint` read. A throwaway probe on this head answered "bar" as shipped and "line" with the line raised above the bars, so the assertion reads the stacking order.

One finding outside this diff: after a runtime lock, the emptied center body keeps the timeline's old cells at zero width. A visitor never sees them, but `querySelector` reads them first, so `measure()` now counts only bodies with a width. I'm filing it as a defect-note.
